messages.ko: 케이콘이 끝나따!!! 케이콘 언제오지 하고 목이 빠져라 기다렸는데 눈 깜빡하니 다 끝나있어서 마음이 후련하면서도 서운하네ㅔ 케이콘에서 깨어도 공개됐는데 어땠어? 이렇게 공개하게 되다니 뭔가 새로웠어 벌써 쇼케도 코앞이라니!!! 시간은 생각보다 더 빠른가봐 이것저것 준비하느라 많은얘기를 공유하지 못해서 미안해 🥹곧있으면 모든게다 공개되고 이땐 어땠는지 저땐 어땠는지 하면서 얘기할 생각하니까 벌써 기대돼 우리 이렇게 큰무대 설 수 있게해줘서 너무너무 고맙구 우리 활동도 재밌게 해보자아 너무 행복하다! 무대할 수 있어서ㅎㅎ
messages.en: KCON is over!!! I've been waiting forever for KCON to come, and then I blinked and it was already over. I feel relieved, but at the same time a little sad. We also revealed Are You Alive at KCON. What did you think? It felt really special revealing it like that. And the showcase is already just around the corner!!! Time really passes faster than I expected. I'm sorry I couldn't share much with you because I've been busy preparing so many things. 🥹 Soon everything will finally be revealed, and I'm already excited thinking about telling you what everything was like behind the scenes. Thank you so, so much for making it possible for us to stand on such a big stage. Let's have lots of fun during this promotion too. I'm so happy! Just being able to perform on stage makes me happy. ㅎㅎ
I'm on the phone ordering room service right now.
"Moshi moshi! Yes, yes! That's right! Yes!"
At first I thought you were saying, 'Naniga suki'....
I still can't believe I performed at KCON.
Honestly, it still doesn't feel real.
I was happy that I got to show things like the cover challenge.
I'm kind of an expert at that.
Even if my dancing isn't perfect,
no one can outdo me at looking chic.
So... are you finally going to reveal the secret behind your nails?
